newsitem.title: ISRAEL: 50 Israeli firms to attend Amman business fair.
newsitem.headline: 50 Israeli firms to attend Amman business fair.

text.p: A delegation representing some 50 Israeli companies will participate in a European Union-sponsored Middle East business fair in Amman next week, the Israel Export Institute said on Thursday.
It said the companies are in the food, plastics and packaging, chemicals, software, metals and machinery and trade sectors and include several Israeli-Arab companies.

About 150 Jordanian companies are expected to participate in the Medpartenariat fair, as well as more than 500 European and Middle Eastern companies, including firms from Egypt, Turkey, Tunisia, Morocco, and the Palestinian Authority.
The institute said companies from Syria and Algeria, with whom Israel has no diplomatic relations, had been invited as well.

Mickey Admon, who is in charge of Middle East activities for the Export Institute, said the Medpartenariat was a uniquely productive forum for Israeli companies to make contact with their counterparts in the Arab world.

He said there was a great deal of interest on the part of Jordanian companies is establishing joint ventures with Israeli concerns, especially to use Jordan as a conduit to selling goods elsewhere in the Middle East.
The Medpartenariat fair has taken place several times before, including in Israel in 1995. Twelve Middle East countries belong to it, inlcuding Lebanon, Cyprus and Malta.
